summary: Ankama's live tactical MMORPG, with the current Unity client separated from the official legacy service.

entries.title: Dofus

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current Unity client at the display's native resolution.

primary.why: Use the maintained live client: Dofus 3 moved the main game to Unity and is the supported route to the current servers and current content. The official Dofus Retro service preserves an older ruleset, but it is a separate legacy branch rather than a missing-content add-on for the modern game.
primary.how_to_play: Install the current Ankama Launcher and Dofus 3 client on Windows. Record the client version and server because this is a live game whose balance, interface, and available content continue to change.

secondary.exclusive_content: No exclusive content; these are native-client fallbacks for the same live service.
secondary.what_to_play: Use the current Dofus 3 client on either supported desktop OS if Windows is unavailable.
secondary.why: The account and live content route are the same; choose by local compatibility rather than content.

all_releases.reason: skip: the main live service has moved forward to the Unity client.

all_releases.fidelity: Current maintained desktop renderer and interface.
all_releases.reason: primary: supported access to the current live game and its current content.

all_releases.fidelity: Official preservation service for an older version of Dofus.
all_releases.reason: skip for the main run: a separate legacy service, not an exclusive-content segment missing from Dofus 3.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The current Unity client is both the maintained and most complete live route. Dofus Retro is historical preservation, not a completeness patch.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is a live-service migration, not a frozen remaster. Interface, rendering, balance, and content can change after this recommendation; record the exact client build and server.
